verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a free business account for 'managing and receiving cash in USD, EUR, GBP, & CAD' with multi-currency balance storage, and a Boleto/Bolepix API for collecting in Brazil via local rails. The evidence never says founders get local account details such as IBANs, sort codes or routing numbers for each currency. Missing for 10: explicit local account details per currency, documentation of how inbound payments are received, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can receive payments using local account details in multiple currencies

citations.quote: managing and receiving cash in USD, EUR, GBP, & CAD - all through one free business account
Multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield, real-time FX conversion, and multi-currency balance storage
It also supports **Bolepix**, which adds a Pix QR code to the boleto for instant settlement through Pix rails.
